description: Header file defining the MtpDevice class for managing MTP (Media Transfer Protocol) device interactions, including session management, object handling, and data transfer functions within the Android platform.

classes.name: MtpDevice
classes.description: Class encapsulating MTP device operations, including session control, object management, and data transfer.

methods.name: MtpDevice
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MtpDevice with USB device parameters and endpoints.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Static method to open an MTP device given device name and file descriptor.

methods.name: ~MtpDevice
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up MtpDevice resources.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the MTP device.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the MTP device connection.

methods.description: Prints device information.
